decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a diverse set of speakers ranging from the high-fidelity Edifier 2.1 system to portable models from Bose and JBL. While the JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) has excellent ratings, the $149 price point is a bit steep for my current budget. The Bose SoundLink Color II (prod_bluetooth_speakers_137) is well-regarded but has several reviews mentioning limited longevity (failing after a year), which makes me hesitant. The budget options like EDUPLINK and Raymate offer good value but mixed feedback on sound quality. Since I am looking for a balance of premium sound and long-term reliability without exceeding $100, none of the current options perfectly meet my criteria.
